chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Products of the human Body.
chapter_note: Exceptionally clean substrate chapter. A systematic five-fold degree mapping of food → body productions, moving from the most subtle (rapture/Mind) to the most gross (corporeal offspring). Both sides of every mapping stay within the body-cosmos system. No editorial bridge, no institutional content, no exhortation, no citations. The only non-substrate material is the 7-word opening dialogue frame formula. The five-degree structure follows the characteristic pattern: invisible/immeasurable → progressively material → visible. The closing observation about the visibility gradient (parents notice only the fifth because the others 'are not displayed') is part of the teaching's explanatory structure, not editorial addition. Negative editorial fatigue score confirms no drift toward later layers.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic attribution with no cosmological content. 'Once again he speaks to his disciples' — standard dialogue frame marker.

paragraphs.core_text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sets up the five-fold teaching structure. Impersonal, systematic description of a natural process (food → body products). Both sides of the mapping are within the body-cosmos system. No editorial markers despite zero substrate vocabulary score — the pipeline's substrate vocabulary targets zoomorphic/metal/taste markers absent from this body-process teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First degree of the five-fold enumeration. The most subtle production: rapture rising in Mind, issuing from all limbs, immeasurable. This is the highest degree — invisible, diffuse, connected to Mind (nous). Classic correspondential description of spiritual heat or inner illumination as body-process.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second degree. Speech/voice as body production from food. Still subtle but more defined than the first (rapture). The degree structure descends toward materiality.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third degree. Physical strength and activity. Midpoint of the five-fold sequence — bodily exertion, corresponding to sweat/physical output.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth degree. Sexual fluids. More material than strength, approaching the fully corporeal. Lacuna [s] in 'lu[s]t' preserved. The description stays impersonal and systematic.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth and final degree — the most material production: children, corporeal creatures. The closing observation about visibility is part of the teaching structure, not editorial addition. It explains the degree hierarchy: the fifth is visible ('displayed'), the other four are not. This is a teaching about the gradient from subtle to gross — the structural explanation of why people recognize only the grossest production. Both sides of the mapping remain within the body-cosmos system. Lacuna [lo]ve preserved.
